definitions.gloss: right to control; ruling authority; dominion; sovereignty
definitions.explanation: The authority or right to exercise control over a territory, organization, or resource. Used in political, legal, and business contexts.

examples.japanese: {支配権|しはいけん}を{握|にぎ}る。
その{地域|ちいき}の{支配権|しはいけん}をめぐって{争|あらそ}いが{続|つづ}いた。
examples.english: Conflict continued over control of the region.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{支配権|しはいけん}が{新|あたら}しい{経営陣|けいえいじん}に{移|うつ}った。
examples.english: Control of the company was transferred to a new management team.

notes:
Composed of {支配|しはい} (control, domination) and {権|けん} (right, authority). Refers to the legitimate or de facto authority to exercise control. Often used in discussions of political power, colonial history, corporate governance, and legal disputes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {支配権|しはいけん}を{握|にぎ}る: to seize control
- {支配権|しはいけん}を{失|うしな}う: to lose control
- {支配権|しはいけん}が{移|うつ}る: control shifts
- {支配権|しはいけん}をめぐる{争|あらそ}い: struggle over control

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {主権|しゅけん}: sovereignty — specifically national sovereignty over a state or territory
- {覇権|はけん}: hegemony — dominance on a larger scale, often international
- {統治権|とうちけん}: governing authority — focuses on the legal right to govern
